title: All three confidential clients share the same hardcoded client secret 'secret'
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Michael Stonis; component: Identity.API/
rationale: webapp and webhooksclient secrets now read from configuration (Identity:Clients:WebApp:Secret / :WebhooksClient:Secret) via a fail-fast GetClientSecret helper — no committed fallback. RequirePkce=true on both code-flow clients, with UsePkce=true on both ASP.NET senders so the server requirement is met. MAUI deliberately left as-is: it is a public client whose secret ships in the binary; conversion to true public client is out of scope (documented in-code). AppHost wires the same values into Identity.API and the matching clients as Aspire secret parameters.
variants_checked: Only Config.cs:52/82/118 use .Sha256 secrets; the two server-side senders updated; MAUI SettingsService constant left with a scope note; webhook 'Token = secret' in functional tests is unrelated.
bypass_considered: The old shared secret no longer authenticates webapp/webhooksclient; PKCE is now enforced on the PKCE-exempt path; missing config fails closed at startup naming the key.
test_note: Existing IdentityConfigurationTests fixture updated with dummy config keys (required by the fail-fast helper); no new test — config wiring only.
review_reason: Fail-fast configuration replaces the committed credential at the root; the AppHost/test hunks are required counterparts to supply values and keep tests green; maui deferral is justified and documented.
